name: Dilettante Implementer (Core Occultist)
body:
You learned to dabble with another occultist implement.

Prerequisite(s): Amateur Occultist, Int 13, 1 rank in Use Magic Device, no levels in a class with the mental focus class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a new implement and can use it with one focus power of your choice from another school of magic, different from the one you selected with Amateur Occultist.

Special: This feat can be selected more than once. Every time you select it, you gain an implement and one focus power from a different school of magic. If you gain levels in a class that has the mental focus class feature, you can immediately trade this feat for the Extra Focus Power feat.
